The home side are out for revenge against Palace, who thrashed them 5-1 when the sides met at Selhurst Park in November.

Leicester have been the story of the season in the top flight, and they play their final home game of the campaign against an Everton side who have failed to live up to their own expectations.

Highlights of the 2016 FA Cup final between Manchester United and Crystal Palace. Manchester United were hoping to win their first FA Cup title since 2004 and their twelfth in total, which would see them move level with Arsenal. To do so, United needed to repeat their triumph from the 1990 final between these sides, a match in which current Palace manager Alan Pardew was playing.

The BBC will bring audiences a month-long festival of European football including every step of England, Wales and Northern Ireland's journeys at Euro 2016, alongside Europe's elite Gary Lineker presents highlights from the opening game of Euro 2016, in which hosts France took on Romania at the Stade de France, Paris.

Dan Walker presents live coverage of the second match of Euro 2016 as Albania take on Switzerlan This is Albania's first-ever appearance at a major finals and expectations will be high back home that they can caused an upset against the Swiss, whose talisman is Stoke's Xherdan Shaqiri.

Gary Lineker presents live coverage as Wales play their first match of Euro 2016 against Slovakia in Bordeaux. Wales are making their debut at the finals of a European Championship and it is the first time they have played in a major tournament since the 1958 World Cup. Led by talisman Gareth Bale, Chris Coleman's side take on a Slovakia team captained by Liverpool's Martin Skrtel.

eps.t: MOTD Live - Poland v Northern Ireland
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents live coverage of Northern Ireland's first-ever match at a European Championship finals as they take on Poland. Boss Michael O'Neill has targeted a place in the knockout stage in France, but they face a tricky opening match in Group C against a Poland side containing striker Robert Lewandowski, who top scored in qualification with 13 goals.

Gary Lineker presents live coverage of Germany's opening match of Euro 2016 as they take on Ukraine in Lille. Joachim Low's side were World Cup winners two years ago in Brazil, but they have not been at their best since and have suffered a string of defeats, most notably against England in a friendly in March. Group C opponents Ukraine qualified for France via the play-offs.

eps.t: MOTD Live - Republic of Ireland v Sweden
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents live coverage of the Euro 2016 group match between the Republic of Ireland and Sweden at the Stade de France. The Republic of Ireland are taking part in their third European Championship campaign, and will be hopeful of winning only their second ever finals match – the last was a famous victory against England at Euro '88.

Live coverage of the Euro 2016 match between Belgium and Italy, presented by Gary Lineker. The clash at the Stade de Lyon should be one of the outstanding games of the group stage. The Belgians boast a very strong squad, featuring Premier League stars such as Eden Hazard and Romelu Lukaku, and are among the tournament favourites.

Gary Lineker introduces live coverage of the Euro 2016 group game between Portugal and Iceland in Saint-Etienne. Iceland are making their debut at a major tournament but their squad contains several talented players – such as Swansea midfielder Gylfi Sigurdsson, who was their top scorer in qualifying with six goals. As ever, Portuguese hopes rest largely on the brilliance of Cristiano Ronaldo.

Dan Walker presents live coverage as Russia and Slovakia, both group rivals of England and Wales, battle it out in Lille. Russia, the 2018 World Cup hosts, are looking to re-establish themselves on the international scene. They were inaugural European champions in 1960 as the Soviet Union and have finished as runners-up on three occasions.

The BBC bring live coverage of the unmissable moment of the opening week as England face Wales in a blockbuster home nations clash. The mouth-watering encounter is one of the most intriguing matches of the group stages, and has been eagerly awaited since the draw was made last December.

eps.t: MOTD Live - Czech Republic v Croatia
eps.d: Gary Lineker is joined by studio guests Thierry Henry, Danny Murphy and Neil Lennon for live coverage of the Group D game between Czech Republic and Croatia in Saint Etienne Croatia have twice reached the quarter-finals, on debut in 1996 and again in 2008, and they boast one of the strongest midfields in world football, headlined by Real Madrid's Luka Modric and Ivan Rakitic of Barcelona.

Mark Chapman introduces live coverage of the Euro 2016 group game between Iceland and Hungary at the iconic Stade Velodrome in Marseille. With a population of just 330,000, Iceland is the smallest country to have qualified for a European Championship or World Cup. But they were hugely impressive in qualifying, beating the Netherlands home and away and also defeating the Czech Republic and Turkey.

Gary Lineker presents live coverage of the Euro 2016 group match between Portugal and Austria at the Parc des Princes in Paris. Portugal are consistent performers at the European Championship, reaching at least the quarter-finals in each of the last five tournaments. They were beaten finalists as hosts in 2004, and suffered heartbreak again in 2012, losing on penalties to Iberian rivals Spain.

Manish Bhasin introduces coverage as Romania take on Albania in their final group game at Euro 2016. Trevor Sinclair and Dion Dublin provide studio analysis, with commentary from Simon Brotherton and Mark Lawrenson.

The two sides also met at the group stage of the 2014 World Cup, with France recording an impressive 5-2 victory - although both teams went on to reach the knock-out stage. The Swiss laboured in qualification for Euro 2016, losing home and away to England, so a win against their neighbours and tournament hosts would be a real coup for Vladimir Petkovic's side.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the final group matches involving England and Wales in Group B. England face Slovakia in Saint-Etienne, while Wales take on Russia in Toulouse. With both games kicking off simultaneously, could both home nations secure their progress to the last 16? Gary is joined by Alan Shearer and Danny Murphy.

eps.t: MOTD Live: Northern Ireland v Germany
eps.d: Michael O'Neill's side face a tough match against Joachim Low's World Cup winners at the Stade de France in Paris. The Germans are blessed with a frightening array of talent across their squad - can the Northern Irish upset the odds and book a place in the last 16? Gary is joined in the studio by Alan Shearer, Neil Lennon and Jens Lehmann. Commentary comes from Jonathan Pearce and Gerry Armstrong.
Live coverage as Ukraine and Poland face each other at the Stade Velodrome, Marseille, in their final group match at Euro 2016. Commentary by Simon Brotherton and Mark Lawrenson.

Northern Ireland conclude their group fixtures with a daunting match against 2014 World Cup winners Germany, while group rivals Poland and Ukraine meet in Marseille. In Group D, defending Euro 2012 champions Spain play Croatia and the Czech Republic finish off against Turkey.

Portugal have reached at least the quarter-finals in each of the last five tournaments and boast the most celebrated European player in the modern game, Cristiano Ronaldo. The Portugal captain could make a record 17th appearance in the European Championship finals in this game.

In Group E, the Republic of Ireland faced 2012 finalists Italy in Lille, while Zlatan Ibrahimovic's Sweden were up against a fancied Belgium side. Portugal met Hungary in Group F, with Iceland and Austria also in action. There is also another chance to watch the Republic of Ireland's final group match against Italy on BBC Two between 2am and 3.40am.

Relive all the goals, drama and analysis from the day's three Premier League games, including title-chasing Arsenal's visit to Wolverhampton Wanderers. The Gunners have won their last five Premier League clashes against Wolves, including a 2-0 victory at Molineux last season after a brace from Martin Odegaard.

Relive all the goals, drama and analysis from the day's three Premier League games, including title-chasing Arsenal's visit to Wolverhampton Wanderers. The Gunners have won their last five Premier League clashes against Wolves, including a 2-0 victory at Molineux last season after a brace from Martin Odegaard.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's seven Premier League matches, including title-chasing Liverpool's game away to West Ham. The Merseysiders have won nine of the last ten meetings between the two teams in all competitions, including a 3-1 victory at Anfield in the reverse league fixture.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's six Premier League matches, including title-chasing Arsenal's match at home to Bournemouth. In this fixture at the Emirates Stadium last season, the Gunners came from 2-0 down to stun the Cherries, thanks to a brilliant winner from Reiss Nelson in the 97th minute.

Gary Lineker presents highlights from all the day's fixtures on the penultimate weekend of Premier League action, which includes Manchester City's trip to Fulham. City, who have been involved in one of the most exciting title races in years, thrashed Fulham 5-1 at the Etihad earlier this season and will be looking for another three points today.

Gary Lineker presents a bumper edition of Match of the Day as all 20 teams meet on the final day of the 2023/24 Premier League season. This campaign has been thrilling at both ends of the table, with a host of teams battling it out for the title and fighting to avoid relegation.

eps.t: The FA Cup 2023/24 Final: Manchester City v Manchester United
eps.d: Gary Lineker hosts live coverage of the FA Cup final between holders Manchester City and twelve-time winners Manchester United at Wembley. This is the first time since 1885 that the FA Cup final will be contested by the same two clubs in consecutive years.

eps.t: The FA Cup 2023/24 Final Highlights: Manchester City v Manchester United
eps.d: Another chance to see the best of the action from the 2024 FA Cup final between local rivals Manchester City and Manchester United. The two sides are contesting the final of English football's showpiece club competition for a second successive season, with City victorious 12 months ago thanks to a 2-1 win.

Germany v Scotland. Alex Scott presents action from the Group A match at Munich Football Arena, as the tournament got under way. The hosts are looking to emulate their last triumph in this tournament at Euro 96, while Scotland are aiming to progress beyond the group stage of a major tournament for the first time.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Italy v Albania
eps.d: Coverage of the Group B match from BVB Stadion Dortmund, as the current holders play their first match of the competition. Italy finished second in their qualifying group behind England, after losing both of their matches against Gareth Southgate's side. They will be looking to become the first country since Spain in 2012 to successfully defend the title, and start as clear favourites here.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Poland v Netherlands
eps.d: Mark Chapman presents coverage of the Group D match from Volksparkstadion Hamburg. The Netherlands will be looking to improve on a disappointing recent record in Euros finals, having not made it past the quarter-finals since 2004. In 2021, they sailed through their group, finishing top with three wins out of three and scoring eight goals in the process, only to lose to Czechia 2-0 in the last 16.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Serbia v England
eps.d: Coverage of the Group C match from Arena AufSchalke in Gelsenkirchen, as Gareth Southgate's men kick off their tournament. The Three Lions famously finished runners-up at the previous finals, losing on penalties to Italy in the showpiece match, despite taking an early lead through a Luke Shaw goal.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Romania v Ukraine
eps.d: Mark Chapman presents coverage of the Group E match from Munich Football Arena. Romania finished top of their qualifying group ahead of the likes of Switzerland and Israel to make it to this tournament, and are playing in the finals for the first time since 2016.

Alex Scott presents the latest action from Germany, featuring Romania v Ukraine at Munich Football Arena and Belgium v Slovakia at Frankfurt Arena in Group E, and Austria v France at Dusseldorf Arena in Group D, as the six nations got their tournaments under way.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Turkiye v Georgia
eps.d: Coverage of the Group F match from BVB Stadion Dortmund, as Georgia make their first ever appearance at a major finals. The Crusaders beat 2004 champions Greece in a play-off final to qualify for this event, winning 4-2 on penalties after a tense game ended goalless.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Portugal v Czechia
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents coverage of the Group F match from Leipzig Stadium, as 2016 champions Portugal make their entry into the tournament. They'll be looking to improve on a disappointing defence of their title three years ago, when they went out at the last-16 stage in a 1-0 defeat to Belgium in Seville.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Germany v Hungary
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents coverage of the Group A match from Stuttgart Arena. Germany haven't won any of the last three meetings between the two, and the last fixture saw Hungary come out on top with a 1-0 victory in a UEFA Nations League match. These two also met in the group stage at the previous Euro finals in 2021, with the game ending in a thrilling 2-2 draw.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Scotland v Switzerland
eps.d: Gabby Logan presents coverage of the Group A match from Cologne Stadium. Steve Clarke's side have high hopes of reaching the knockout stages for the first time in their history, having performed impressively in their qualifying group. They beat Spain 2-0 at home, as well as winning 2-1 away in Norway, to help them on their way to reaching the finals for the second successive occasion.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Denmark v England
eps.d: Coverage of the Group C match from Frankfurt Arena, as the two sides meet for the first time since their semi-final battle at Euro 2020. The Three Lions beat their Scandinavian counterparts 2-1 after extra-time thanks to Harry Kane's deciding penalty, which took Gareth Southgate's team to their first major final since 1966.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Slovakia v Ukraine
eps.d: Coverage of the Group E match from Dusseldorf Arena, as both sides play their second group game. Both of these teams finished third in their groups in the Euro finals three years ago, but only Ukraine made it through to the knockout stages thanks to their superior record.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Netherlands v France
eps.d: Coverage of the Group D match from Leipzig Stadium, as two former champions face each other in an eagerly awaited encounter. Ronald Koeman's Dutch team are looking to win their first major title since 1988, when they beat the Soviet Union 2-0 in the final thanks to goals from Ruud Gullit and Marco Van Basten.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Georgia v Czechia
eps.d: Coverage of the Group F match from Volksparkstadion Hamburg, in what is the first-ever meeting between the two countries. Czechia have had some positive runs in this competition since they first entered as Czech Republic in 1996, when they finished runners-up to Germany. Since then, they have reached a semi-final in 2004, as well as two quarter-finals in 2012 and 2021.

Alex Scott presents action from the latest matches in Germany, featuring Turkiye v Portugal at BVB Stadion Dortmund and Georgia v Czechia at Volksparkstadion Hamburg in Group F, and Belgium v Romania at Cologne Stadium in Group E. Portugal and Belgium will both have fancied their chances of having strong tournaments, but faced potentially difficult encounters today.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Scotland v Hungary
eps.d: Gabby Logan presents coverage of the Group A match from Stuttgart Arena, as both teams play their final group game. Steve Clarke's side will be looking to make it into the knockout stages of the Euros for the first time in their history at the fourth time of asking.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Switzerland v Germany
eps.d: Mark Chapman presents coverage of both sides' final Group A match, held at Frankfurt Arena. Hosts Germany have secured their place in the last 16 after thrashing Scotland 5-1 in the opening match, before prevailing 2-0 against Hungary, but they will now be keen to ensure they top the group and thus earn a potentially favourable draw in the last 16.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Croatia v Italy
eps.d: Coverage of the Group B match from Leipzig Arena, where one of the most intriguing groups of the tournament reaches a conclusion. Croatia will be looking to continue a decent run of form at major tournaments and make it through to the knockout stages, having made it out of the group stages in the past four competitions since 2016.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Albania v Spain
eps.d: Gabby Logan presents coverage of the Group B match from Dusseldorf Arena, where both nations are set to conclude their round-robin fixtures, in a group that also contains Croatia and Italy. Spain have progressed from the group stages of the Euros on each of the previous four occasions, including reaching the semi-finals in three of the last four championships and, alongside hosts Germany, they're…

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - France v Poland
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents coverage of both sides' final Group D match from BVB Stadion Dortmund. France, still under long-term coach Didier Deschamps, are trying to avoid missing out on reaching the knockout stages of the Euros for just the second time this century, having previously finished bottom of their group back in 2008.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Netherlands v Austria
eps.d: Coverage of the Group D match from Olympiastadion Berlin, as both teams play their third and final group fixture. The Netherlands have reached the semi-finals three times since 1992, but have to find a squad to replicate the achievements of 1988, when they famously won the tournament with a line-up that included the likes of Ruud Gullit, Marco van Basten and Ronald Koeman, who is now in charge of…

Alex Scott presents action from the latest action from Germany, featuring England v Slovenia at Cologne Stadium and Denmark v Serbia at Munich Football Arena in Group C, and France v Poland at BVB Stadion Dortmund and Netherlands v Austria at Olympiastadion in Group D.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Ukraine v Belgium
eps.d: Coverage of the Group E match from Stuttgart Arena, which sees the group reach a conclusion. Belgium have fared well at major tournaments since the turn of the century, with their 'Golden Generation', but have yet to win the major tournament that would seal their place in the history books.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Slovakia v Romania
eps.d: Coverage of the Group E match from Frankfurt Arena, as both sides conclude their round-robin fixtures. Slovakia are playing at their third consecutive European Championship finals and are looking to improve on Euro 2021, when they failed to make it past this stage.

Alex Scott presents action from the final day of the group stage in Germany, featuring Ukraine v Belgium at Stuttgart Arena and Slovakia v Romania at Frankfurt Arena in Group E, and Czechia v Turkiye at Volksparkstadion Hamburg and Georgia v Portugal at Arena AufSchalke in Group F.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Switzerland v Italy
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents live coverage from the knockout stages of Euro 2024 as reigning champions Italy continue the defence of their crown against unbeaten Switzerland.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Portugal v Slovenia
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents live coverage from the Euro 2024 knockout stage as 2016 champions Portugal face underdogs Slovenia in Frankfurt.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Romania v Netherlands
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents live coverage of the last 16 clash between Group E winners Romania and the Netherlands in Munich.
Alex Scott with comprehensive highlights from the last 16 of Euro 2024, as Austria take on Turkey and Romania face the Netherlands.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Quarter-Finals: Portugal v France
eps.d: Live coverage of a blockbuster Euro 2024 quarter-final between Cristiano Ronaldo's Portugal and Kylian Mbappe's France, with the sides meeting in a repeat of the 2016 final.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Quarter-Finals: England v Switzerland
eps.d: The unmissable drama of England's Euro 2024 campaign continues as they take on Switzerland for a place in the semi-finals in Gareth Southgate's 100th game in charge.
Alex Scott presents comprehensive highlights from the quarter-finals of Euro 2024, including England's quarter-final against Switzerland and Netherlands v Turkey.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Semi-Finals: Spain v France
eps.d: Coverage of the opening semi-final, which comes from Munich Football Arena, where the winners of the first and second quarter-finals meet. Spain were far from their best during Euro 2020, but still managed to reach this stage, before losing to eventual champions Italy in a penalty shootout.

Netherlands v England. Action from the second semi-final, as the winners of the third and fourth quarter-finals met at BVB Stadion Dortmund. England prevailed 2-1 against Denmark at this stage of Euro 2020 to reach their first European Championship final, and were looking to repeat that feat against a Dutch side managed by one of their arch-nemeses from years gone by, Ronald Koeman.

eps.t: MOTD Live: UEFA Euro 2024 - Final: Spain v England
eps.d: Coverage of the final, which comes from Olympiastadion in Berlin, where England are aiming to win the tournament for the first time. Somewhat surprisingly, this is the first meeting between the two at a major finals since Euro 96, when England progressed via a penalty shootout after a goalless draw at Wembley Stadium.
Gary Lineker introduces highlights from the opening seven games of the new Premier League season, including Liverpool's trip to Suffolk to face newly promoted Ipswich.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Tottenham Hotspur v Everton, and Aston Villa v Arsenal. Spurs went into their match against the Toffees looking to extend an eight match unbeaten run that included three consecutive home victories, while Villa were aiming to continue their own good form against the Gunners that saw them win both encounters last…

Gary Lineker presents highlights from the day's seven Premier League matches, featuring Arsenal against Brighton and West Ham United v Manchester City. Arsenal did the league double over the Seagulls without conceding last season, including a 2-0 triumph at the Emirates, while City also defeated West Ham in both league meetings – the Blues' 3-1 triumph on the final day was enough to secure a…

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Manchester City v Brentford at Etihad Stadium and Southampton v Manchester United at St Mary's Stadium. The Citizens claimed a 1-0 win over Brentford in last season's corresponding fixture, but they lost home and away to them in the 2022/23 campaign.

Gary Lineker presents highlights from a busy day of Premier League action with eight games taking place, including Manchester United's trip to the capital to face Crystal Palace. Erik ten Hag's side were beaten 4-0 at Selhurst Park last season, with the Eagles completing a league double over the Red Devils for the very first time.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's seven Premier League games, including the match between Newcastle United and reigning champions Manchester City. Pep Guardiola's side have not lost to the Magpies in the top flight since 2019, though they did bow out of the League Cup at St James' Park last season.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's seven Premier League games, including reigning champions Manchester City at home to Fulham. Pep Guardiola's side have not lost to the Cottagers in the top flight since 2009 and won 5-1 in last season's corresponding fixture, with Erling Haaland scoring a hat trick. Arsenal host newly promoted Southampton, while Liverpool visit Crystal Palace.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's seven Premier League games, including the London derby between Tottenham and West Ham. The Hammers enjoyed the bragging rights last season after taking four points off their bitter rivals, including a famous 2-1 victory away at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's five Premier League games, featuring reigning champions Manchester City against newly promoted Southampton.
Gary Lineker presents highlights from the day's seven Premier League matches, including Arsenal's visit to Newcastle United.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights from all of Saturday's Premier League matches. The day's games include an entertaining-looking clash between Brighton and Manchester City, while Liverpool host Aston Villa in another match with ramifications for the top of the table.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Arsenal v Nottingham Forest and Manchester City v Tottenham Hotspur. Arsenal beat Forest 2-1 home and away last term, but Nuno Espírito Santo's men have made an excellent start to the current campaign.

Gary Lineker introduces the goals, drama and best reaction from the weekend's Premier League fixtures, including the London derby between West Ham United and Arsenal. The Gunners secured their biggest Premier League away win in February with a ruthless 6-0 dismantling of West Ham, who suffered their heaviest home defeat in the division.

All the best action, reaction and analysis as Arsenal host old foes Manchester United in one of eight midweek Premier League fixtures. Mikel Arteta's Arsenal scored twice in stoppage time to secure a dramatic home victory in last season's corresponding fixture and went on to complete a league double over United for the first time since 2006/07.

Gary Lineker introduces the goals, drama and reaction from the day's Premier League fixtures, including the final top-flight Merseyside derby to be played at Goodison Park. Everton leave Goodison at the end of this campaign to move to a new stadium at Bramley Moore Dock and will be desperate to sign off in style against their city rivals following a 2-0 win in this fixture last season which…
Gary Lineker introduces highlights from the day's five matches in the Premier League, including Fulham's trip to Liverpool and an all-Midlands clash between Nottingham Forest and Aston Villa.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights from all of the day's Premier League matches, including Manchester City's visit to Aston Villa and the London derby between Arsenal and Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park. Brentford, who have been involved in plenty of exciting matches this season, hosted Nottingham Forest, who have so far exceeded expectations in this campaign, thanks to the prolific scoring of…

Gary Lineker introduces highlights from all the Boxing Day Premier League fixtures, which feature both Manchester City and Liverpool. Champions City hosted Everton in the lunchtime fixture, while title challengers Liverpool had an evening kick-off against Leicester City.

Kelly Somers introduces highlights from the day's six Premier League matches, including Manchester City's visit to Leicester and Liverpool's trip to face West Ham United. Pep Guardiola's side have won their past four visits to the King Power Stadium without conceding, while the Foxes last victory in this fixture was a shock 5-2 triumph in September 2020 in which Jamie Vardy scored a hat-trick.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Manchester City v West Ham United at Etihad Stadium and Brighton & Hove Albion v Arsenal at AMEX Stadium. Erling Haaland's second successive hat-trick gave City a 3-1 win when they met the Hammers at London Stadium in August.

eps.t: The FA Cup Third Round: Manchester City v Salford City
eps.d: Live coverage as League Two Salford City aim to cause a massive upset against reigning Premier League champions Manchester City in the FA Cup third round.

eps.t: The FA Cup Third Round: Highlights
eps.d: Watch all the goals, drama and reaction from football's oldest cup competition as Premier League giants lock horns with lower league underdogs.

eps.t: The FA Cup Third Round: Arsenal v Manchester United
eps.d: Gary Lineker introduces live coverage as Arsenal and Manchester United, the two most successful sides in FA Cup history, battle it out for a place in the fourth round.

Highlights from eight midweek Premier League games, including tonight's eagerly anticipated north London derby between Arsenal and Tottenham. The Gunners are unbeaten in each of the past five meetings between the two clubs, and they won both of last season's games by a single-goal margin. Spurs have only won one league fixture at the Emirates Stadium, with that victory coming in 2011.

Highlights from all of the day's Premier League fixtures, including pace-setters Liverpool's visit to Brentford, who have impressed with their free-flowing football this season. Arsenal and Aston Villa, who both finished in the top four last season, meet at the Emirates Stadium, and Leicester City host Fulham.

Highlights from another exciting day of action in the Premier League, with the day's six fixtures headlined by Manchester City's heavyweight clash with Chelsea. When City beat the Blues at Stamford Bridge on the opening weekend of the season, few would have predicted the struggles Pep Guardiola's side have gone on to suffer.
Gary Lineker presents highlights from another exciting day of Premier League action, featuring key games at the foot of the table.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Leyton Orient v Manchester City
eps.d: Live FA Cup action from east London as reigning Premier League champions Manchester City seek to avoid a colossal upset against League One Leyton Orient in the fourth round.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Birmingham City v Newcastle United
eps.d: Gary Lineker introduces live FA Cup fourth-round action as third-tier Birmingham City attempt to knock out Premier League high-flyers Newcastle United.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Highlights
eps.d: All the goals and highlights from the FA Cup fourth-round ties that have taken place so far this weekend, including Manchester City's visit to League One Leyton Orient.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fourth Round: Aston Villa v Tottenham Hotspur
eps.d: Mark Chapman hosts live coverage of a mouthwatering all-Premier League tie between Aston Villa and Tottenham, two sides that have won the FA Cup 15 times between them.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction from the eight Premier League games played so far this weekend, including Manchester City v Newcastle and Leicester v Arsenal. Manchester City spent heavily in January to reinvigorate their squad and had won 15 successive home league matches against Champions League-chasing rivals Newcastle prior to this meeting.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights from all the day's Premier League matches, which include a London derby between Arsenal and West Ham. The Gunners won 5-2 when the sides last met in November and will be hopeful of picking up another three points in the reverse fixture on their own turf.

Highlights from the midweek Premier League matches, which include title chasers Liverpool hosting Newcastle United at Anfield. The reverse fixture at St James' Park in December was a thrilling 3-3 draw, the latest in a long line of entertaining clashes between these two teams.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Crystal Palace v Millwall
eps.d: Coverage of the fifth-round match from Selhurst Park, where the London rivals battle for a place in the quarter-finals. The last time these sides faced each other was in a third-round tie in the 2021/22 season, and on that occasion, it was the Eagles who prevailed with a 2-1 win at The Den.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Highlights
eps.d: Jason Mohammad presents action from the fifth-round ties, including Manchester City v Plymouth Argyle at Etihad Stadium, and Preston North End v Burnley at Deepdale. Championship strugglers Plymouth were looking to land another monumental blow against top-flight opposition after eliminating Liverpool last time out, while local Lancashire rivals put EFL matters to one side as they battled for a…

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Manchester United v Fulham
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents all the action from the fifth-round tie at Old Trafford. Holders United have endured a disappointing top-flight campaign so far, but they have eliminated two top-flight teams in Arsenal and Leicester City in this competition.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights from another crucial round of fixtures in the Premier League, headlined by Nottingham Forest welcoming Manchester City to the City Ground. While Nuno Espirito Santo's Forest side have been a revelation this season, the same cannot be said of defending champions City.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights of the day's five Premier League games, including the clash between Manchester City and Brighton. The Seagulls triumphed 2-1 when the sides met in November, but they have never won a competitive match away to City.

eps.t: The FA Cup Quarter-Final: Brighton & Hove Albion v Nottingham Forest
eps.d: Gary Lineker introduces live coverage of Nottingham Forest trying to reach their first FA Cup semi-final for 34 years as they take on Brighton & Hove Albion at the Amex Stadium.

eps.t: The FA Cup Quarter-Final: Preston North End v Aston Villa
eps.d: Mark Chapman hosts live coverage as Preston North End, the only Football League side left in this season's FA Cup, contest their first quarter-final since 1966, taking on Aston Villa.

Highlights from nine midweek Premier League matches, including the Merseyside derby between Liverpool and Everton and Manchester City's game with Leicester. Runaway leaders Liverpool will hope to take another step towards their second Premier League title.

Gary Lineker presents highlights of the day's five Premier League games, including the battle for Champions League places between Aston Villa and Nottingham Forest. At the other end of the table, Ipswich Town hosted relegation rivals Wolves. Elsewhere, Arsenal travelled to Everton, Crystal Palace took on Brighton and West Ham met Bournemouth.

Gary Lineker introduces highlights from the day's Premier League games, which will impact both ends of the table. Champions League-chasing Nottingham Forest host Everton, while Arsenal face Brentford at the Emirates. Last year's champions Manchester City play Crystal Palace, Leicester City are at Brighton, and Aston Villa travel to Southampton.
Gary Lineker introduces highlights and reaction from the day's five Premier League games, including Manchester City's final visit to Goodison Park to take on David Moyes's Everton.

eps.t: The FA Cup Semi-Final: Crystal Palace v Aston Villa
eps.d: Join Gary Lineker for live coverage of the FA Cup semi-final between Crystal Palace and seven-time winners Aston Villa at Wembley, with a place in the 144th FA Cup final at stake.

Mark Chapman brings you all the goals, reaction and analysis from the day's five Premier League games, including Newcastle United's clash with Ipswich Town at St James' Park. Eddie Howe's side are looking to secure a top-five finish and a return to the Champions League after winning their first major domestic silverware in 70 years last month.
Mark Chapman introduces highlights of the two FA Cup semi-finals at Wembley. Manchester City face Nottingham Forest, while Crystal Palace take on Aston Villa.

Gary Lineker brings you all the goals, reaction and analysis from five Premier League games, including the clash between Champions League-chasing Aston Villa and Fulham. Villa have had another excellent campaign under Unai Emery and are desperate to book a return to European's premier club competition after their brilliant run to the quarter-finals this season.

Gary Lineker brings you all the goals, reaction and analysis from the day's five Premier League games, including the clash for European football between Bournemouth and Aston Villa. Villa are attempting to reach the Champions League in back-to-back seasons, and they take on a Bournemouth side with European aspirations of their own.

eps.t: The FA Cup 2024/25 Final: Crystal Palace v Manchester City
eps.d: Gary Lineker presents all the action from the final, which comes from Wembley Stadium. Palace are looking to lift the trophy for the first time in their history, having been runners-up to Manchester United in 1990 and 2016, and their impressive 3-0 wins over Fulham and Aston Villa in the quarter-finals and semi-finals respectively will give them hope.
Action from Crystal Palace v Manchester City in the 144th staging of the showpiece match in the world's oldest domestic cup competition, held at Wembley Stadium.

The best of the action from the final day of the Premier League season, presented – for the last time – by Gary Lineker. The former England striker, who has hosted the flagship highlights show since 1999, bows out with a bumper crop of ten games, with all eyes on the race for European places.
Highlights from the first weekend of the 2025/26 Premier League season. There are six matches to enjoy, including two games involving newly promoted Sunderland and Burnley.
Highlights from the first Sunday of the new Premier League season, with Manchester United taking on Arsenal at Old Trafford. Plus Chelsea v Crystal Palace and Brentford v Nottingham Forest.

Mark Chapman presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Chelsea v Fulham at Stamford Bridge and Manchester United v Burnley at Old Trafford. Fulham claimed a 2-1 away win over their London rivals last term thanks to late goals by Harry Wilson and Rodrigo Muniz, and United were held to a 1-1 draw by Burnley here when the sides last met two seasons ago.

Kelly Cates presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Arsenal at Anfield and Brighton & Hove Albion v Manchester City at AMEX Stadium. Liverpool and the Gunners finished first and second in the league last term and shared the spoils here in a 2-2 draw after the Reds had already secured the title.
Mark Chapman presents highlights of the day's action in the Premier League. Arsenal face Nottingham Forest, Wolves go to Newcastle, West Ham host Tottenham, and Brentford take on Chelsea.

Kelly Cates presents highlights from both of Sunday's Premier League games, including an early-season Manchester derby. Liverpool look to maintain their 100 per cent record when they take on Burnley at Turf Moor, and there are some crackers to choose from in August's Goal of the Month.

Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Everton at Anfield and Manchester United v Chelsea at Old Trafford. Reigning champions Liverpool will have been expecting three points and bragging rights against their Merseyside neighbours.

Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Arsenal v Manchester City at Emirates Stadium. Arsenal claimed a stunning 5-1 win in last season's corresponding fixture, with five different players finding the net for the Gunners, but Pep Guardiola's men will have been determined to give a better account of themselves this time around.

Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Crystal Palace v Liverpool at Selhurst Park and Manchester City v Burnley at Etihad Stadium. The Eagles and Liverpool had already met once this term in the Community Shield, with Palace prevailing on penalties after a 2-2 draw.

Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, featuring Newcastle United v Arsenal at St James' Park and Aston Villa v Fulham at Villa Park. Newcastle won three of the four meetings between them and the Gunners in all competitions last term, including a 1-0 victory here in the league.

Gabby Logan presents highlights of five Premier League games, including Chelsea against Liverpool at Stamford Bridge. West Ham go to Arsenal, Leeds take on Tottenham, Manchester United face Sunderland, and it's Bournemouth versus Fulham on Friday night.

Kelly Cates presents highlights from Sunday's five Premier League games, including Manchester City's trip to Brentford. Ange Postecoglou's Nottingham Forest travel to Newcastle, Aston Villa take on Burnley, Brighton go to Wolves and Crystal Palace are the visitors at Everton's new Hill Dickinson Stadium.
Gabby Logan presents highlights of the day's seven Premier League games, including Manchester City v Everton, Brighton v Newcastle and Crystal Palace v Bournemouth.
Mark Chapman presents highlights of Liverpool against Manchester United and Tottenham versus Aston Villa.

Highlights of five Premier League matches, including champions Liverpool's visit to Brentford. Manchester United welcome Brighton to Old Trafford, while newly promoted Sunderland are in action at Chelsea. Elsewhere, Newcastle face Fulham, plus highlights of Friday's game between Leeds and West Ham.

Highlights of five Premier League matches, including Arsenal v Crystal Palace at the Emirates and Aston Villa v Manchester City. Elsewhere, Bournemouth take on Nottingham Forest, Everton host Spurs, and Wolves chase a first home win of the season against newly promoted Burnley.

Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Aston Villa at Anfield and Tottenham Hotspur v Chelsea at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Champions Liverpool claimed a 2-0 home win over the Villans last term, while the Blues claimed a memorable 4-3 victory over Spurs in the corresponding fixture 11 months ago.

Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, featuring West Ham United v Newcastle United at London Stadium and Manchester City v Bournemouth at Etihad Stadium. Newcastle claimed a 1-0 win away to the Hammers last term, but the Londoners will hope to fare better under the stewardship of Nuno Espírito Santo.

City were looking to do the double over their local rivals after winning 3-0 at Etihad Stadium in September, and Arsenal also won 3-0 when they hosted Forest earlier in the campaign.

Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, featuring Wolverhampton Wanderers v Newcastle United at Molineux and Aston Villa v Everton at Villa Park. Newcastle claimed a 1-0 win over struggling Wolves at St James' Park in September. Villa and the Toffees drew 0-0 in the reverse fixture, but the Midlanders will have expected to claim all three points in front of their own fans.

High-flying Manchester City welcome last-placed Wolves to the Etihad, while Liverpool travel to Bournemouth. At the top of the table, Arsenal take on Sunderland, Aston Villa travel to Bournemouth, whilst Manchester United face Tottenham in the day's early game. At the bottom of the table, there's a massive game between Burnley and West Ham, and Leeds welcome Nottingham Forest to Elland Road on Friday night.

Mark Chapman presents highlights of two Premier League games including Liverpool against Manchester City at Anfield, with City having beaten the defending champions 3-0 in the reverse fixture back in November. Elsewhere, Crystal Palace travel to Brighton as the two sides resume their rivalry following a 0-0 draw earlier this season.

eps.d: Hull City look to kick off the FA Cup fourth round with an upset when they host Chelsea, with Liam Rosenior taking his new team back to the one he used to manage.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fo:urth Round Aston Villa v Newcastle United
eps.d: Two Premier League sides go head-to-head for a place in the fifth round of English football's oldest cup competition. Aston Villa have won the trophy seven times compared to Newcastle's six victories, but neither side has lifted the famous trophy since the 1950s.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fo:urth Round Highlights - Saturday
eps.d: Alex Scott presents highlights from the day's FA Cup fourth-round ties as EFL clubs Salford City and Burton Albion seek to cause upsets against Manchester City and West Ham. There's also action from the all-Premier League clashes between Aston Villa and Newcastle and Liverpool and Brighton.

Action from the latest Premier League matches, including Manchester City v Newcastle United at Eithad Stadium, and Aston Villa v Leeds United at Villa Park. Newcastle beat Pep Guardiola's men 2-1 in November's reverse fixture, but have since lost to them home and away in the EFL Cup. The Villans were unbeaten in their last six meetings with Leeds and won 2-1 at Elland Road this term.

Gabby Logan presents highlights of Sunday's four Premier League games with the north London derby between Spurs and Arsenal, Liverpool's trip to Nottingham Forest, plus Crystal Palace against Wolves and Sunderland versus Fulham.

Liverpool host West Ham at Anfield, Everton go to Newcastle, Burnley face Brentford, and Sunderland make the long trip to Bournemouth, while Friday night's game sees Aston Villa make the short journey to Molineux.

Highlights of the midweek Premier League matches, including Brighton & Hove Albion v Arsenal at Amex Stadium and Newcastle United v Manchester United at St James' Park. The Gunners' title challenge continued against a Brighton side that have struggled in the second half of the season, while the Red Devils were looking to complete a league double over the Magpies.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Wolverhampton Wanderers v Liverpool
eps.d: Wolverhampton Wanderers v Liverpool (Kick-off 8.00pm). All the action from the fifth-round tie at Molineux. Wolves have defeated two lower-league teams in Shrewsbury Town and Grimsby Town to reach this stage and now face a sterner test against the Reds, who they also met in the Premier League three days ago.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Wrexham v Chelsea
eps.d: Mark Chapman presents all the action from the fifth-round tie at StoK Racecourse. Wrexham have progressed from the National League to fighting for promotion to the Premier League since being taken over by Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds in 2020, and they have already defeated one top flight team here in this cup run, overcoming Nottingham Forest on penalties in round three.

eps.t: The FA Cup Fifth Round: Highlights
eps.d: Highlights of the fifth-round ties, including Fulham v Southampton at Craven Cottage, and Leeds United v Norwich City at Elland Road. Top-flight sides Fulham and Leeds will both have expected to progress to the last eight at home to Championship outfits, with United boss Daniel Farke taking on his former club. Plus, a round-up of Saturday's action.

eps.d: All the action from the quarter-final at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea are yet to play a Premier League team in this season's competition and after making short work of Charlton Athletic and Hull City, they were taken to extra time by Wrexham before eventually prevailing 4-2.
